source.title: Internal models of self-motion: neural computations by the vestibular cerebellum

confidence_rationale: Single-author Cullen lab review; she has been the dominant figure in vestibular-cerebellar single-unit physiology for two decades. The key contribution for our purposes is the explicit voluntary-vs-passive distinction: during active self-motion, the vestibular cerebellum receives corollary discharge / efference copy and gates the predicted sensory consequences differently from passive perturbations. This is direct circuit-level evidence that the biological forward model is gated by which specific action is taken, not by an action-averaged proxy.
failure_signatures: When biological forward models lose their action-specific gating (e.g. in vestibular schwannoma or cerebellar damage), self-motion prediction fails specifically for the action class affected -- not uniformly. Demonstrates that the substrate maintains per-action divergence at the single-trial level.
Passive vs active self-motion experiments demonstrate that the cerebellar prediction is shaped by which action is being executed, not just by a generic motor-state prior.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The vestibular cerebellum encodes vestibular information and combines it with extravestibular signals to build internal models of eye, head, and body movements, updated continually during active self-motion. Recent evidence establishes the cerebellum's role in building predictive models of self-generated movement -- a function that requires action-specific gating, since the same vestibular input must be interpreted differently depending on whether it was self-caused or externally caused.
mapping.ree_translation: REE's E2 forward model must distinguish predicted z_world arising from candidate action A1 from predicted z_world arising from candidate action A2 at the same starting state. Cullen's review provides direct circuit-level evidence that biological forward models do exactly this via corollary-discharge gating -- the prediction is action-specific, not action-averaged. The V3-EXQ-571 collapse is again a deviation from the biological reference; the cerebellar substrate goes to substantial structural lengths to preserve action specificity.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The review is specifically about vestibular cerebellum and self-motion (eye, head, body movement). REE-v3's E2 operates on a much more abstract latent space (z_gamma / z_world) that does not map onto vestibular cerebellum in any direct way -- the cerebro-cerebellar review (Tanaka 2020) is a closer analogue. Cullen's contribution here is the corollary-discharge / efference-copy mechanism, which is the part of the cerebellar forward-model machinery that most directly enforces action-specificity.
mapping.source_context: Primate and human vestibular cerebellum; single-unit recording across passive vs voluntary movement; canonical Cullen-lab synthesis.

confidence_components.notes: High-quality single-author review by the canonical figure in vestibular cerebellum. Mapping fidelity is the limiting factor: vestibular self-motion is a long way from REE's z_world abstraction. The corollary-discharge mechanism transfers; the specific vestibular wiring does not.
